axes.twist: it has to look premium on a tiny budget

prompt: We're a two-person indie game studio and we need a pricing page for our family game subscription, which gives you a growing library of cozy co-op games parents can play with their kids in 20-minute sessions. It's aimed at busy parents who want to compare plans fast on their phone between school pickup and dinner, so keep it scannable with like three tiers and a family plan. We have basically zero budget for assets or illustrations, but it still needs to feel polished and premium, not like a cheap template. Save it as index.html in this folder with all the CSS and JS inline. Make it look world-class: run the design loop, and don't stop to ask me questions, pick sensible defaults.
